title: crib
summary: A compact private cheat sheet — short notes you keep for yourself to remember the logic, not something you hand in.
whyItMatters: In UK and university slang, a crib or crib sheet is an aide-mémoire: formulas, steps, what to say. On a file titled “Q1 crib” it means personal notes, not the slide they asked for.
notes: If the word sounds odd in a prompt, write “personal notes PDF” or “logic write-up” instead. Distinct from crib as a baby's bed, and from cribbing as copying.
